observations: White vertical game console with PlayStation logo on the front panel.
A black controller is resting on top of the console.
The console is sitting on a wooden desk next to a fan and various cables.
The background features several game posters, including 'The First Descendant' and 'God of War Ragnarok'.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI OLAYIWOLA NOAH' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.evidence: The exterior appears clean, but internal condition and usage history cannot be confirmed from a single photo.

claims.claim: never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have a faulty HDMI port.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting to the home screen and a clear shot of the HDMI port.

risks.risk: The internal storage capacity (500GB vs 1TB) is unknown.
risks.proof: A photo of the 'Storage' settings screen in the system menu.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN).
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully logging into a PSN account.

risks.risk: The controller may have stick drift or other mechanical faults.
risks.proof: A video of the controller being used to navigate menus or a controller tester app.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the console powering on and navigating the system menu.
Photo of the 'Storage' screen showing the total capacity.
Video of the console connected to a TV and playing a game.
Photo of the rear ports and the power cable.
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
